# opnsense_ipsec_manual_spd (Data Source)

Manual security policy database entries (**VPN ▸ IPsec ▸ Manual SPD**), for example to route extra networks through a route-based tunnel.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the IPsec manual SPD entry.

### Read-Only

- `connection_child` (String) ID of the `opnsense_ipsec_child` the entry belongs to.
- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `destination` (String) Destination network, in CIDR notation.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the entry is enabled.
- `protocol` (String) IPsec protocol.
- `request_id` (Number) Request ID of the child SA the policy is bound to.
- `source` (String) Source network, in CIDR notation.
